summary: Iteration 10 - Testing new absence types (annual_leave, sick_leave_paid, sick_leave_unpaid) for TANSEEQ HR System. All 8 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend code review verified: 1) Notes column (ملاحظات) present in attendance table, 2) Manual entry badges (إدخال يدوي) displayed for manual records, 3) Absence type dropdown with 5 types in 3 optgroups, 4) Deduction preview with green/orange colors based on absence type.

✅ Backend returns no_deduction=true and total_deduction=0 for annual_leave and sick_leave_paid
✅ Backend returns no_deduction=false and total_deduction>0 for full_day, half_day, sick_leave_unpaid
✅ Frontend AttendanceManagement.js (lines 1112-1129): Dropdown with data-testid='absence-type-select' has 3 optgroups and 5 options
✅ Frontend (lines 1145-1161): Deduction preview shows green 'بدون خصم' for annual_leave/sick_leave_paid, orange 'مع خصم' for others
✅ Frontend (lines 647-653): Notes column shows 'إدخال يدوي' badge for records with manual_entry, manual_absence, or is_manual_entry flags
